maddeler.e:
تحتجزوا (form VIII)
# تَحْتَجِزُوا (taḥtajizū) /taħ.ta.d͡ʒi.zuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
# تُحْتَجَزُوا (tuḥtajazū) /tuħ.ta.d͡ʒa.zuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
